# heytownhall_management_tokens (Data Source)

The organisation's management tokens: names, scopes and dates, never the tokens themselves. Tokens are made and revoked in the dashboard, not through the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "heytownhall_management_tokens" "all" {}

# Tokens that can still be used and have not been used for a while are worth revoking in the dashboard.
output "active_token_names" {
  value = [for t in data.heytownhall_management_tokens.all.tokens : t.name if t.revoked_at == null]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `tokens` (Attributes List) The tokens. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tokens))

<a id="nestedatt--tokens"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tokens`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the token was created (RFC 3339).
- `created_by` (String) The email address of the owner who made the token.
- `display` (String) The token's prefix and last four characters.
- `expires_at` (String) When the token expires (RFC 3339), or null.
- `id` (String) The token's id.
- `last_used_at` (String) When the token was last used (RFC 3339), or null.
- `name` (String) The token's name.
- `revoked_at` (String) When the token was revoked (RFC 3339), or null.
- `scopes` (List of String) The scopes, such as `keys:write`.
- `status` (String) `active`, `expired`, `revoked`, or `creator_not_owner` (the owner who made the token is no longer an owner, so the token no longer works).
